consequence.statement: No operational consequence for existing setups: the field is optional and, when unset, service discovery defaults to the value defined in the Prometheus/PrometheusAgent resource, so existing ServiceMonitors continue to work unchanged; operators may optionally set the new field to 'Endpoints' or 'EndpointSlice'.

assertion.statement: The monitoring.coreos.com/v1 ServiceMonitor CRD schema gained a new optional field spec.serviceDiscoveryRole, a string enum accepting "Endpoints" or "EndpointSlice" that defines the service discovery role used to discover targets and otherwise defaults to the value defined in the Prometheus/PrometheusAgent resource.
